title: git-vouch-migrate verify-continuity
description: Verify a person's continuity proof against pgpkeys@C: people/<h>.json.asc detached GPG signature over the exact person file by the migratedFrom key (expired-but-unrevoked accepted, D9: handle EXPKEYSIG explicitly), or the SSH key is the GPG key's auth subkey (binding verified by gpg). SSH side via importing git-vouch's own verification (never reimplemented). Reports duplicate fingerprint claims (D3).
acceptance_criteria: Tests with throwaway GPG keys: valid .asc passes; foreign key NO_PUBKEY fails; swapped SSH key fails; expired key passes; revoked key fails; auth-subkey reuse passes; two-key person file (any-one-key .sig) passes.
notes:
Lane C2-migrate 2026-10-22: implemented 'git-vouch-migrate verify-continuity --commit C --signer FPR PGPKEYS REGISTRY [HANDLE...]' and verify_continuity(pgp, root, handles) -> Continuity(proven, failed, duplicates) for vouch-omzm.3 to import. SSH side = vouch.check_registry(root).people (valid person files) + vouch.signer_of per .sig block; nothing reimplemented. GPG side: key in pgpkeys@C not revoked/invalid (expired ok, D9), every file email on an unrevoked UID, then proof = (a) a .sig block by a current unrevoked person key equal to gpg --export-ssh-key of a live ed25519/P-256 auth subkey (the auth subkey must SIGN; listing a public subkey proves nothing), else (b) .asc: one detached class-00 signature, GOODSIG or EXPKEYSIG (gpg exits 0 for both; REVKEYSIG/BADSIG/NO_PUBKEY/ERRSIG/EXPSIG rejected), VALIDSIG primary == migratedFrom. D3: fingerprint (case-normalised) claimed by >1 valid person file fails all claimants. Exit 1 if any reported handle fails. Tests: tests/migrate/test_continuity.py (13; real gpg, ssh-keygen, gpg-agent ssh socket for auth-subkey signing). Fixture: frank is now revoked only in pgpkeys keys/, not in the signing home (port output unchanged). Mutation-checked: each rule's removal fails a test. Smoke: real pgpkeys@af88128 with empty registry runs in ~10s. Not closed (later stage).
Review 2026-10-22: strict auth-subkey rule (subkey must sign) is now an open QUESTION on vouch-omzm, not a settled decision. Late cutoff is unowned by this bead; QUESTION on vouch-omzm plus a new child bead. Added tests: migratedFrom not in pgpkeys, malformed migratedFrom, named handle without migratedFrom, HANDLE filter (unnamed provable claim not reported), retired and registry-revoked auth subkey that signs (git-history registries), two-signature .asc, .asc by a signing subkey revoked in pgpkeys (REVKEYSIG; conftest: carol gets a signing subkey revoked only in pgpkeys, via a second gpg home). Mutation-checked: each reviewer mutation now fails a test; the NEWSIG/GOODSIG/len(valid) guards overlap, so only removing all three fails the two-signature test.
